newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh jails Russian for gold smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh jails Russian for gold smuggling.

text.p: A Bangladesh court has sentenced former Russian diplomat Vladimir Lankin to 10 years in jail for smuggling gold worth $1 million into the country, court officials said on Saturday.

Judge Azizul Huq of the special court dealing with smuggling said in his verdict on Wednesday that Lankin, a former diplomat in the Russian Embassy in Dhaka, was guilty of smuggling in 640 gold bars worth $1 million.
He was arrested by customs officials at Dhaka airport on January 25, 1993 trying to collect two cartons sent from Singapore containing the gold.
He has been in jail since his arrest.
Government sources said Lankin left his diplomatic job in 1992 and worked for a private business.
The court also sentenced Kalim Bin Rahman, Lankin's business associate, to life imprisonment. Rahman was still at large and was sentenced in absentia.
